data.title: Amaal 8
data.about:
Amaal 8 at Meydan Horizon, Dubai offers a luxurious lifestyle in a prime location within the Meydan Horizon masterplan, across from the tranquil Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Rising across 48 levels, Amaal 8 redefines contemporary living with 512 elegantly designed units, including the exclusive Infinity Collection Residences.

You can choose from 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments in various layouts, each offering different views. Whether you want to enjoy the sparkling lagoon, the verdant golf course or just the Dubai skyline, you'll find your perfect view at Amaal 8. This project by Amaal Emirates, a part of Ayana Holdings, is a perfect blend of urban convenience and serene natural beauty, offering breathtaking views of Downtown Dubai, the Crystal Lagoon, and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. With smart living technology integrated into each unit, convenience and luxury are at the forefront of the Amaal 8 experience, making these apartments ideal for those seeking an elevated lifestyle in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: An Urban Development Offering Effortless Living!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime location within Meydan Horizon, close to Dubai's major landmarks
  • Each residence offers a unique view, ranging from the Crystal Lagoon and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Creek, and the golf course.
  • Discover family-friendly community spaces and luxury lifestyle offerings.
  • Immerse yourself in luxury with Amaal 8’s aquatic amenities. Whether you're looking for a peaceful lap swim or a sun-drenched day by the infinity pool, Amaal 8 has it all.
  • From valet services to retail experiences, Amaal 8 anticipates and fulfils your urban lifestyle needs with ease and elegance.
  • Enjoy VIP Private Parking at Amaal 8's exclusive, air-conditioned showroom-style garage with ambient lighting and personalized spaces for Infinity Collection owners.

location_tile.title: Where Tranquility Meets Urban Sophistication
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Amaal 8 is situated within the Meydan Horizon masterplan, offering unparalleled connectivity to Dubai's most iconic destinations. This prime location offers residents and investors easy access to Dubai’s major business, entertainment, and leisure hubs, while also being close to the serene Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary.

Designed to accommodate more than 72,000 residents, Meydan Horizon features luxury high-rise apartment projects alongside premium commercial and retail environments. One of its standout features is a 2km long canal, surrounded by a 4km boardwalk, giving residents easy access to stunning waterfront views and leisure activities.

  • Ras Al Khor Sanctuary - 5 Minutes
  • Dubai Design District - 5 Minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 10 Minutes
  • Downtown Dubai - 10 Minutes
  • Jumeirah Beach - 17 Minutes
